Legal

Security Overview

Last updated: 6 September 2026

Security at enterlabs

Documents and personal data require careful handling. We build security into platform development and operations, with controls that help Clients manage access, review activity and choose an appropriate deployment.

ISO/IEC 27001:2022

Confluidity Pte. Ltd.'s information security management system is certified by INTERCERT to ISO/IEC 27001:2022. The certificate annexure includes PT Codemasters Nusantara Innovation's Jakarta site.

The certified scope covers the development, deployment and operation of cloud-based medical insurance claims-processing SaaS for insurers and third-party administrators, including Software Engineering, AI/ML Operations, Security Operations, Business Development and Sales, Data Operations and Corporate Operations.

Certificate number: IC-IS-2608218

Initial certification and issue date: 19 August 2026

Current certificate validity: 19 August 2026 to 18 August 2027

Recertification date: 18 August 2029

Access and separation

Role-based access limits what users can see and do. Tenant separation and distinct development, staging and production environments support the protection of Client data. Authentication, data-access and administrative events are logged to support investigation and review.

Data handling

Encryption measures and redaction controls support the protection and minimisation of data. The Platform implements application-level AES-GCM encryption. Redacted or pseudonymised data remains protected as personal data where it can be linked to an individual.

Managed infrastructure is hosted in AWS Jakarta, with disaster-recovery resources in Singapore. Hybrid deployment options place designated document-processing components within the Client's environment. The applicable agreement records the deployment and processing arrangements.

Finding and addressing weaknesses

Snyk static application security testing and software composition analysis are integrated into the deployment pipeline. Required scans must pass before deployment; failed scans block deployment.

Independent security testing results are shared with Clients under NDA as they become available.

Incident response

We maintain a documented incident-response process. Affected Clients are notified without undue delay in accordance with applicable law and their agreements. Investigation, containment and follow-up are coordinated with the relevant Client.

Continuity

Daily database snapshots and documented business-continuity and disaster-recovery arrangements support recovery planning. Deployment-specific information is available during security review.

People

Personnel are subject to confidentiality obligations, security-awareness training and access controls appropriate to their responsibilities. Access is reviewed periodically and removed when no longer authorised.

Security documentation and reporting

Visit our Trust page to request access to supporting security documentation. Documents require a signed NDA and are watermarked.

Report a suspected vulnerability or security concern to sales@enterlabs.ai.
